partial def reduce_ratio (a : Int) (b : Int) : Int := Id.run do
  let mut a : Int := a
  let mut b : Int := b
  a := (Int.ofNat (Int.natAbs a))
  b := (Int.ofNat (Int.natAbs b))
  if (a == (0 : Int)) then
    return b
  if (b == (0 : Int)) then
    return a
  while (a != b) do
    if (decide (a > b)) then
      a := (a - b)
    else
      b := (b - a)
  return a
